// Package agents detects third-party coding agents that drive the gh CLI so
// they can be identified in the User-Agent header.
package agents

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// AgentName identifies a coding agent.
type AgentName string

const (
	Amp         AgentName = "amp"
	Antigravity AgentName = "antigravity"
	AugmentCLI  AgentName = "augment-cli"
	ClaudeCode  AgentName = "claude-code"
	Codex       AgentName = "codex"
	CopilotCLI  AgentName = "copilot-cli"
	Cowork      AgentName = "cowork"
	Cursor      AgentName = "cursor"
	CursorCLI   AgentName = "cursor-cli"
	GeminiCLI   AgentName = "gemini-cli"
	Goose       AgentName = "goose"
	Kiro        AgentName = "kiro"
	OpenCode    AgentName = "opencode"
	Pi          AgentName = "pi"
	Replit      AgentName = "replit"
)

// Detect returns the coding agent driving the CLI, or "" if none is detected.
func Detect() AgentName {
	return detect(os.Getenv)
}

func detect(getenv func(string) string) AgentName {
	has := func(k string) bool { return getenv(k) != "" }

	// Generic agent declaration wins over everything.
	if v := strings.TrimSpace(getenv("AI_AGENT")); v != "" {
		return AgentName(v)
	}

	// Agent-specific markers.
	switch {
	case has("CLAUDE_CODE_IS_COWORK"):
		return Cowork
	case has("CURSOR_AGENT"):
		return CursorCLI
	case has("CURSOR_TRACE_ID"):
		return Cursor
	case has("ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT"):
		return Antigravity
	case has("AUGMENT_AGENT"):
		return AugmentCLI
	case has("CLAUDECODE"), has("CLAUDE_CODE"):
		return ClaudeCode
	case has("CODEX_SANDBOX"), has("CODEX_THREAD_ID"):
		return Codex
	case has("GEMINI_CLI"):
		return GeminiCLI
	case has("AMP_CURRENT_THREAD_ID"):
		return Amp
	case has("OPENCODE"), has("OPENCODE_CLIENT"):
		return OpenCode
	case has("COPILOT_CLI"):
		return CopilotCLI
	case getenv("TERM_PROGRAM") == "kiro":
		return Kiro
	case pathHasSegment(getenv("PATH"), ".pi"):
		return Pi
	}

	// Replit's marker is present in any Replit environment.
	if has("REPL_ID") {
		return Replit
	}

	// Goose's marker only indicates it is configured as a model provider.
	if has("GOOSE_PROVIDER") {
		return Goose
	}

	return ""
}

// pathHasSegment reports whether any path in the list contains seg as a
// complete path segment, using either Unix or Windows separators.
func pathHasSegment(list, seg string) bool {
	if list == "" {
		return false
	}
	entries := strings.FieldsFunc(list, func(r rune) bool { return r == ':' || r == ';' })
	for _, e := range entries {
		parts := strings.FieldsFunc(e, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' || r == '\\' })
		for _, p := range parts {
			if p == seg {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

	}
